request.description: This is the endpoint the website's backend calls - the exact same JSON shape it used to send Keyloop directly (captured from real production logs, not guessed). Brand is identified by enquiry.apikey - this example uses BMW's confirmed-working key. Saves the returned referenceId into {{referenceId}} for the next two requests.
Shows the resolved brand, forwarded payload, and the raw Keyloop/Genesys responses (or error messages) for this lead.
Re-triggers async delivery to Keyloop/Genesys for a lead that previously ended up KEYLOOP_FAILED / GENESIS_FAILED.

item.name: Sales Screen (agent desktop)

request.description: Any UAE mobile format works: 0501234567, 971501234567, +971 50 123 4567. When nothing matches the registered mobile, every other phone number Keyloop holds for the customer (Phone1-3, landlines, foreign numbers) is tried digit-for-digit - the spec's "search by another phone number" for a caller on an unregistered line. Add `group=BMW` to restrict to one dealer group; `limit` defaults to 20 (max 100).
Case-insensitive exact match on the customer's e-mail.
Keyloop customer number, across groups unless `group` is given. At least one of mobile / email / customerNumber is required (400 otherwise).

Customer profile section: name, mobile (E.164 when it is a UAE mobile, plus the raw value), e-mail, address, branch, customer since, type (LOYAL / CONQUEST...), VIP, do-not-contact, consent flags. 404 when the group + number does not exist.

White on the sheet of 2026-09-21 (Verified By and Verification Date/Time are red font). The sheet's own remark says it is recorded in Genesys; no feed of it reaches this side, so this answers 501 after the usual 404 check.

The customer's vehicles, newest registration first. Every car whose vehicle record names this customer as owner, aftersales customer or driver (`linkedVia`: `OWNER` / `AFTERSALES` / `DRIVER`, from Keyloop's Sales / Aftersales / Drive Customer columns), plus cars on their invoiced enquiries that no vehicle record gives to an owner yet (`INVOICED_ENQUIRY`). A car they bought that the vehicle report now gives to someone else (a resale) is not listed. Keyloop's vehicle export has no engine or transmission column. `mileageKm` is the last odometer reading (Keyloop's 0 = no reading, omitted).

Insurance contracts on the cars the customer owns or bought, from Keyloop's contract export: contractNumber (Keyloop's own contract number - the insurer's Policy No. and the Coverage are in red font on the spec and are not in the export), provider, start and expiry dates, Keyloop status plus a normalised state (ACTIVE / EXPIRED / INACTIVE) and days to expiry. Lost-sale enquiries are never followed.

The customer's financed orders from Keyloop's finance export (core.finance, arrived 2026-09-18): provider (the bank the order was invoiced to), loan amount, monthly payment (EMI), number of payments (tenure), invoice date, the car. Cash sales (Keyloop writes zeros) are left out unless includeCash=true. Outstanding Amount and Status have no source.

From Keyloop's trade-in export (core.tradein): previous vehicle, trade-in date (appraisal date, or valuation date when there was no appraisal), value (total offer; omitted on cancelled trade-ins where Keyloop writes 0), status Completed / Cancelled.

The customer's cases from Keyloop's complaint export (core.complaint), newest first: complaint id, category, department, status (OPEN until Keyloop records a closed date), owner (allocated to), resolution (closure text), created / closed date-times, source, vehicle. Escalation has no source.
Only what Keyloop can answer: the last complaint date and its id. Risk Level, Risk Score and Repeat Complaint Count are in red font on the spec - Genesys derives them from the complaint report.

Total Leads, Open Leads, Won Deals, Lost Deals, Last Purchase Date from the customer's enquiries in Keyloop's enquiry export: won = Invoiced, lost = Lost sale, open = everything else; last purchase = latest invoice date.

Every white section in one call: profile, vehicles, insurance, finance, trade-in history, complaints (10 most recent), risk overview. Rows that are red on the spec are not included. Customer + Vehicle + Sales (salesSummary) + Service (serviceBookings: the customer's open workshop bookings) + Complaint. Interaction data is red font: interactionData is returned empty ("").

item.description:
Read-only API behind the Genesys agent desktop's Sales Screen, one request per section of the screen spec. Answered from the core.* tables (Keyloop's typed mirror); nothing is written back. Only the rows left white on the spec have an endpoint, and red-font fields inside a white row are returned empty (""). Fully red rows - Trade-in Eligibility, Documents, Accessories, Recent Sales Activities, SLA Countdown, Customer Sentiment, AI Assistant, Activity Timeline, Complaint Manager, Notes - are Genesys's or another system's and are not routed.

A customer is addressed by Keyloop group + customer number (`{{group}}` / `{{customerNumber}}`) because the number is only unique within a dealer group. Start with a search (by the caller's mobile, an e-mail, or the number) - it returns both.

Fields Keyloop leaves empty are omitted from the JSON rather than sent as null. No authentication yet.

Red-font fields of a row are part of its response but always empty ("") - they do not come from Keyloop.

Customer phone numbers and e-mail addresses are masked in every response: a phone shows only its last three digits (+*********567), an e-mail its first letter and domain (a***@example.com). Searching by mobile or e-mail still works - the match comes back masked. The test-drive advisor is staff and is not masked.

request.description: Same endpoint as Leads > Submit Lead: the enquiry-shaped JSON the website sends. The lead is forwarded to Keyloop and Genesys; once Keyloop exports it, it appears as a prospect in the read requests below.

Keyloop's leads by mobile, email, prospectNumber or customerNumber. The mobile is tried against the registered number, then every other phone Keyloop holds (the spec's "search by another phone number").
Lead ID, name, mobile, e-mail, lead source, status (OPEN / CONVERTED), customer number once converted, journeys it is enrolled in. Keyloop's prospect export has no Model column.
Lead ID, customer, mobile, source, campaign (contact list), push status. Genesys Contact ID is red font: returned empty ("").

item.name: Display slots to customer (Lead ID, Mobile)

request.description: Black fields on this row are Lead ID and Mobile - both on the prospect. Slot List and Push Status are red font: Genesys builds and pushes the slots.

The demo vehicles seen in bookings over the last sinceDays (default 180), with the branch of their latest booking. Date, Slot ID, Advisor and Date/Time are red font - Genesys runs the roster. Drop branchCode for all branches; it accepts 10 or 0010.
A lead's bookings; also customerNumber=, or date= (with optional branchCode=) for everything on a day. Optional status=.
Customer, Vehicle, Slot, Advisor, Booking ID, Status. Writing a booking into Keyloop is not possible from here.
Booking ID, Advisor (name, mobile, e-mail), Customer, Date/Time. Message ID and Delivery Status are red font.
Booking ID, Customer, and testDriveDone (the trigger). Template and Trigger Status are red font.
Only Booking ID is black on this row - Genesys receives and records the rating, comments and routing. Same response as Trigger feedback: the booking and customer the feedback belongs to.
Booking ID, Customer, Vehicle (with the slot and branch). Message ID and Status are red font.
Enquiries that became orders (Provisional order, Confirmed order, Invoiced) by customerNumber or vin, joined to the car. enquiryNumber= returns that enquiry whatever its status.
The order (Keyloop enquiry number) with its dates, sales executive and the vehicle record.
Booking/Vehicle ID and the dates Keyloop holds (supplier order, order confirmed, planned delivery) plus its stock flag. Production Status is red font.
Vehicle ID and where Keyloop says the car is now. Shipment Status and Tracking No. are red font; Keyloop has no tracking number.
Vehicle ID, registration date and plate. Registration Status is red font.
Customer (number, name, mobile) and Vehicle, with the order's own dates. Milestone, Template, Message ID and Delivery Status are red font.
Vehicle ID with Keyloop's stock flag and delivery date to judge from. Status and Trigger Status are red font.

Customer, Vehicle, Mileage, Last Service Date for cars whose next service date falls within withinDays (overdueDays= also looks back). Page with limit (default 100, max 1000) and offset until a page comes back short. Segment ID and Record Count are in red font on the spec: returned empty ("").
Customer, Vehicle, Booking/WIP, Booking Status: Keyloop's open workshop WIPs across the customer's cars. Also /api/v1/vehicles/{group}/{vin}/service-bookings.
Booking, Advisor (bookedBy), Branch, Date/Time for one WIP. Message ID and Status are red font.
WIP, Vehicle, Service Status for one WIP. Message ID and Delivery Status are red font.
Customer, WIP, Completion Date (dueOutDate) for one WIP. Trigger Status is red font.
Black fields are Customer and Vehicle: the customer's cars. Eligibility, Offer, Message ID and Delivery Status are red font.
Customer ID / Mobile, Customer, Contact Details. Then .../profile for the full record.
Vehicle and VIN for every car the customer owns or bought.
Black fields are Vehicle and Mileage: the vehicle summary. Service Type, Package, Price and Eligibility are red font - no package data exists in Keyloop.
Customer, Vehicle, Booking/WIP No., Status. Package and Slot are red font, and writing an appointment into Keyloop is not possible from here.

Customer, Vehicle, Last Service Date for delivered cars whose last service (or delivery, if never serviced) is over months old. Page with limit (default 100, max 1000) and offset until a page comes back short. Segment ID and Record Count are in red font on the spec: returned empty ("").

Customer, Vehicle, WIP, Date: a lapsed car (as above) that now has an open workshop booking. Update Status is red font and nothing can be written back to Keyloop. Page with limit (default 100, max 1000) and offset until a page comes back short. Segment ID and Record Count are in red font on the spec: returned empty ("").

Customer, Vehicle, Mileage for delivered cars at or over a mileage, or registered at least minAgeYears ago. Age is red font. Page with limit (default 100, max 1000) and offset until a page comes back short. Segment ID and Record Count are in red font on the spec: returned empty ("").

Customer, Vehicle, Expiry Date, Insurance Details (provider, contract number) for active contracts expiring within withinDays. Days to Expiry is red font. Page with limit (default 100, max 1000) and offset until a page comes back short. Segment ID and Record Count are in red font on the spec: returned empty ("").

Customer and Mobile of the same expiring-insurance population. Page with limit (default 100, max 1000) and offset until a page comes back short. Segment ID and Record Count are in red font on the spec: returned empty ("").

Date Range/Month, Customer, Birthday, Contact. month (1-12) with optional day, or from= / to= dates with the year ignored (a range across new year works). Page with limit (default 100, max 1000) and offset until a page comes back short. Segment ID and Record Count are in red font on the spec: returned empty ("").

Customer, Vehicle, Fuel Type from Keyloop's own electric-vehicle export (folder EV, table core.electric_vehicle) - the main vehicle export leaves Fuel Type blank on almost every car, so EVs cannot be told from it. A car's customer is its owner: the Sales Customer on the vehicle record (joined by VIN), else the buyer on its latest invoiced enquiry, matched by vehicle number; cars that belong to nobody yet (stock, demo) are left out. The EV export's own Customer Number (Keyloop's old, wrong column) and Enquiry Number (a copy of the Vehicle Number) are not followed. A car without a chassis yet has no vin. Optional fuelTypes=E narrows by Keyloop's fuel-type code. Ownership Date is red font. Page with limit (default 100, max 1000) and offset; Segment ID and Record Count are red font: returned empty ("").

Lead ID: open, unconverted prospects older than olderThanDays with no test drive booked. Last Interaction Date and Days Inactive are red font - interactions live in Genesys. Page with limit (default 100, max 1000) and offset until a page comes back short. Segment ID and Record Count are in red font on the spec: returned empty ("").

Customer and VIP Flag (Keyloop's own flag). Spend and Purchase Count are red font. Page with limit (default 100, max 1000) and offset until a page comes back short. Segment ID and Record Count are in red font on the spec: returned empty ("").

Saved on this side (app.customer_request) - nothing is written to Keyloop. The same call as the Complaint Screen's "Create Complaint": description is required; category, vin, branch, priority and createdBy are optional. The new id is saved to {{desktopComplaintId}}; read it back with "Monitor complaint status" by setting {{complaintReference}} to it.
Complaint ID, Customer, Mobile for one Keyloop complaint. Template, Message ID and Status are red font.

Complaint ID with OPEN or CLOSED - Keyloop records only a closed date, so In Progress and Re-opened (red font) do not exist. For all of a customer's complaints use .../customers/{group}/{customerNumber}/complaints.
Complaint ID, Customer, Closure Date (complaint.closedDate / closedAt). Message ID and Status are red font.

item.description:
One request per white row of the Sales New Lead Screen (2026-09-18 version). Each serves the fields that are in black on its row; red-font fields (message ids, delivery and trigger statuses, templates, slot lists, ratings, production / shipment / registration statuses, tracking number, segment id, record count...) are Genesys's or another system's: they are returned empty ("").

Fully red rows have no request: Get showroom slots, Create showroom appointment, Return customer response, Get service slots, Anniversary extraction, Push campaign segment, Stop communication after 6 months, Assign relationship manager, Fast-track VIP service.

Read-only over core.* (Keyloop's typed mirror) and the leads table, except the complaint ticket, which writes to a table of our own. Writing bookings or appointments into Keyloop is not possible - they only arrive as Keyloop's exports. Times are dealer-local (+04:00). Fields Keyloop leaves empty are omitted. No authentication yet.

Red-font fields of a row are part of its response but always empty ("") - they do not come from Keyloop.

Customer phone numbers and e-mail addresses are masked in every response: a phone shows only its last three digits (+*********567), an e-mail its first letter and domain (a***@example.com). Searching by mobile or e-mail still works - the match comes back masked. The test-drive advisor is staff and is not masked.

item.name: Enquiries
Enquiries by customer mobile, make and model

request.description: The customer's enquiries for one make and model. mobile in any spelling (+971 50 123 4567 / 0501234567 / 501234567); drop make or model to widen, add status=open|won|lost to narrow by outcome, group= to stay inside one Keyloop group.
Every open enquiry of the customer with this mobile, any make or model. status=all (the default) also lists invoiced and lost ones.
The same list keyed by Keyloop customer number, for a caller that already identified the customer.
One enquiry by its Keyloop number: the row above plus the journeys the engine enrolled it in (J01 showroom appointment, J03 delivery). 404 when unknown.

item.description:
Keyloop enquiries for the agent desktop, found by the CUSTOMER's mobile number and narrowed by make and model. Each row is the enquiry id (Keyloop enquiry number) with everything Keyloop records on it: status (Keyloop's label) and outcome (OPEN / WON / LOST), customer (number, name, masked mobile and e-mail), make (normalised brand) and manufacturer code, model / model code / variant, new or used, branch, sales executive, source, appointment and test-drive dates, order and invoice facts, the car (vehicle number, VIN and the vehicle record when Keyloop has it) and, on a lost sale, the reason and date.

The mobile is matched on the customer record (registered mobile first, then every other phone Keyloop holds for them), never on the enquiry's own "Mobile Phone Number" column - in Keyloop's export that column is the sales executive's. make=BMW also covers BMW i (brand BMW_I); MINI, Motorrad and Rolls-Royce are their own makes. model matches whole words in any spacing ("X5", "5 series", "Countryman", or the model code "G05"); "X1" does not find an iX1. Read only, newest first, limit max 100. Times are dealer-local (+04:00).

item.name: Service Booking Screen

request.description: Registered mobile first, then any other phone Keyloop holds (the spec's "search by another phone number"). Also email= or customerNumber=.
Customer ID, name, mobile, e-mail, location, customer since. Language is in red font: returned empty ("").

Model, VIN, mileage, last service date, next service due and the insurance contracts on the car. warranty and serviceContract are the one-line covers from Keyloop's warranty and service-contract exports (status, provider, type, expiry).

Every car whose vehicle record names the customer (owner, aftersales customer or driver), plus cars on their invoiced enquiries that no vehicle record gives to an owner yet; newest registration first. customerNumber on each car is its aftersales customer.

Vehicle ID, Mileage, Warranty Coverage (the live warranty's provider text, e.g. "BMW Extended Warranty 5y/200,000 km") and warranty status / expiry, Service Contract Status / type / expiry - from Keyloop's warranty and service-contract exports (folders WAR and SVC, since 2026-09-22). Service Type and Eligibility are red font: returned empty (""). Status is ACTIVE / EXPIRED / INACTIVE, or NONE when Keyloop has no contract of that kind for the car.

Customer ID and Vehicle ID are the only fields in black on this row (service type, branch, advisor, slot, date/time are red font) and Keyloop has no booking write API. So this saves the request - this customer wants this car booked - in app.customer_request (kind SERVICE_BOOKING) for the workshop to pick up. Nothing appears in Keyloop or in Get Open Bookings until the workshop books it there.
Booking ID, WIP / Job Card No. and Booking Status - the fields in black. New Slot, New Date/Time, Advisor and Confirmation Time are in red font, so there is nothing to write.

kind COMPLAINT or REQUEST; vin and createdBy optional. Returns Customer ID, Vehicle ID, text and Status. Service Booking ID, Request ID and Saved Timestamp are in red font: returned empty (""). A saved complaint shows up on the Complaint Screen under its Complaint ID (AGMC-<id>), where it is updated and resolved.

item.name: List a customer's complaints and requests

request.description: Newest first; limit (default 50, max 200).

Booking ID, Customer ID, customer name, Mobile and the appointment (date, time, branch, service, car, status). Message ID and Delivery Status are in red font - Genesys sends the message. Keyloop's booking export names no customer, so it is the car's Aftersales Customer on the vehicle record (then its owner, then the invoiced buyer while the record names nobody); omitted when the car is in neither.
Booking ID, Customer ID and the appointment being reminded of. Reminder Date, Message ID and Delivery Status are in red font.

Customer ID, Feedback, Date of the SERVICE and CSI feedback submitted through POST /api/v1/feedback (Feedback Screen) plus Keyloop's after-sales service survey answers (FID feed, core.feedback). Booking ID and Rating are in red font. Optional bookingId=, from=, to=, limit=.

White on the sheet of 2026-09-21. Customer ID, Vehicle ID, Mileage and Service History - what a recommendation is made from. Recommended Package, Recommendation Reason and Recommendation Type are red font: returned empty (""), for whoever runs the model to fill.

item.description:
The rows of the Service Booking Screen that are not fully red (sheet of 2026-09-20), with red-font fields kept in each row's response but always empty ("").

Fully red, no endpoint: Get Trade-in Eligibility (was yellow, removed), Get Service Types, Get Workshop Availability, Get Service Slots, Get Available Service Advisors, Cancel Booking, Get Recommended Service Packages, Get Package Details, Calculate Service Estimate, Check Additional Services, Get Customer Activity (removed).

Times and dates are dealer-local (+04:00). Fields with no value are omitted rather than sent as null. No authentication yet.

Customer phone numbers and e-mail addresses are masked in every response: a phone shows only its last three digits (+*********567), an e-mail its first letter and domain (a***@example.com). Searching by mobile or e-mail still works - the match comes back masked. The test-drive advisor is staff and is not masked.

request.description: Registered mobile first, then any other phone Keyloop holds (the spec's "search by another phone number"). Also email= or customerNumber=.
Customer ID, name, mobile, e-mail, location, customer type (LOYAL / CONQUEST...). Language is in red font: returned empty ("").
Identity verification is recorded in Genesys when the agent does it and no feed of it reaches this side: answers 501 after the usual 404 check. Verified By and Verification Date are in red font.

VIN, registration, model, year, mileage, fuel type, colour, service dates the insurance contracts on the car, and its warranty and serviceContract covers. Engine and Transmission are not in Keyloop's vehicle export.
Every car the customer bought, newest registration first.

Vehicle ID, Warranty Status (ACTIVE / EXPIRED / INACTIVE / NONE), Expiry Date and provider of the warranty that matters (active first, then the latest to end), with every warranty Keyloop holds for the car in contracts[]. From Keyloop's warranty export (WAR, since 2026-09-22). Coverage is red font: returned empty ("").

Vehicle ID, Contract Type (SERVICEINCL, ASI8Y...), Status (ACTIVE / EXPIRED / INACTIVE / NONE), Expiry Date and provider of the service contract that matters, with every one Keyloop holds for the car in contracts[]. From Keyloop's service-contract export (SVC, since 2026-09-22). Coverage is red font: returned empty ("").
Mileage, Next Service Date and Due Mileage from the vehicle record. Remaining Days/KM is in red font, so nothing is computed against today - no remaining figures and no overdue / due-soon status.

Last service date and mileage from the vehicle record; branch and service type from the latest closed workshop booking when Keyloop's export has one (source WORKSHOP_BOOKING), else source VEHICLE without them.

item.name: Open workshop bookings by Vehicle ID

request.description: Booking ID, Service Type, Date, Time, Branch, Status from Keyloop's open-WIP export. Loan Car is in red font: returned empty (""). includeClosed=true for every exported WIP.

item.name: Open workshop bookings by Customer ID

request.description: The same across every car the customer bought. Optional from= / to= bound the appointment date.

Cost is in red font. Keyloop's booking export is the OPEN-WIP list, so until a closed-WIP history feed exists most cars show the vehicle record's last service and whatever is currently booked. from / to are optional.
Claim ID and Date are in black, but no Keyloop feed carries warranty claims or workshop invoices: 501 after the usual 404 check.

Customer ID, Feedback, Date of the SERVICE and CSI feedback submitted through POST /api/v1/feedback, plus Keyloop's after-sales service survey answers (FID feed, core.feedback). Rating and Score are in red font. Optional bookingId=, from=, to=, limit=.

White on the sheet of 2026-09-21. Last Complaint (date and complaint id) from Keyloop's complaint export. Risk Level, Risk Score and Repeat Complaints are red font - Genesys derives them - and are returned empty (""). Same endpoint as the Sales Screen's Customer Risk Overview.

item.name: Complaint Screen

request.description: Registered mobile first, then any other phone Keyloop holds (the spec's "search by another phone number"). Also email= or customerNumber=.
Customer ID, name, mobile, e-mail. ID, Loyalty Tier, Preferred Branch and Communication Preference are in red font.
Identity verification is recorded in Genesys when the agent does it and no feed of it reaches this side: answers 501 after the usual 404 check. Verified By and Verification Date are in red font.
Complaint ID, Category, Priority, Open Date across both origins, newest first. status=open (default) or all. Status (it is the filter) and SLA Due are in red font.

Complaint ID, Category, Branch (location), Priority, Status, Opened On, with the customer's name and mobile. Works for a Keyloop reference and for AGMC-<id>. Subcategory and Assigned Team are in red font. Set {{complaintId}} to {{desktopComplaintId}} to read one created here.

Open Complaints and Resolved Today (dealer time zone) by branch / date range (from=, to= on the opened date) / user (Keyloop's allocated-to or raised-by, the desktop's createdBy). branch accepts the code (10 or 0010), the name or Keyloop's whole label. {
  "keyloopGroup": "{{group}}",
  "customerNumber": "{{customerNumber}}",
  "category": "Customer Handling Skills",
  "department": "Service",

request.description: Customer ID, Category, Description, Branch, Priority (LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH / CRITICAL) in; Complaint ID (AGMC-<id>), Status, Created Date out. Saved on this side only. Subcategory is in red font.

Any of status (OPEN / IN_PROGRESS / CLOSED), priority, category, comment; returns the updated status and date. 409 for a Keyloop complaint. Uses {{desktopComplaintId}}, which "Create a complaint" fills in - run that first.
Action ID, Action Type, Owner, Status, Due Date. Actions are ours (app.complaint_action) and can hang off a Keyloop complaint or one created here.
actionType is required; status defaults to OPEN.
Any of actionType, description, owner, dueDate, status (OPEN / IN_PROGRESS / DONE / CANCELLED); returns the action with its updated date.
Resolution Code, Resolution Notes, Resolution Status (OPEN / RESOLVED), Resolved Date. For a Keyloop complaint the code is Keyloop's closure text and there are no notes. Resolution ID is in red font.
resolutionCode required. 409 for a Keyloop complaint. Uses {{desktopComplaintId}}, which "Create a complaint" fills in - run that first.

Complaint Count by Branch, Category and Status across both origins, largest first. Optional branch=, category=, status= (OPEN / IN_PROGRESS / CLOSED). Resolution Time, SLA Breaches and Escalations are in red font.

White on the sheet of 2026-09-21. Complaint ID, Team/Agent ID, Assignment Status (ASSIGNED / UNASSIGNED), Assigned To. For a Keyloop complaint it is Keyloop's allocated-to name (Keyloop has no id for it); for one created here it is what the desktop assigned.
Gives a complaint created here to a team or agent; send both fields empty to unassign. 409 for a Keyloop complaint. Uses {{desktopComplaintId}}, which "Create a complaint" fills in.

item.description:
The rows of the Complaint Screen that are not fully red. A complaint has one of two origins: KEYLOOP (core.complaint, Keyloop's export, read-only, Complaint ID = Keyloop's reference) or DESKTOP (created here, app.customer_request, Complaint ID = AGMC-<id>). Nothing is written back to Keyloop, so updating or resolving a Keyloop complaint answers 409. Keyloop records no priority.

Red font, returned empty (""): subcategory, assigned team, SLA due / breaches, escalations, resolution time, resolution id, loyalty tier, preferred branch, communication preference.

Fully red, no endpoint: Get Escalation Details, Escalate Complaint, Get SLA Status, Get SLA Breaches, Get Root Cause, Update Root Cause, Get Compensation Details, Approve Compensation, Send Customer Update, Get Complaint Activity, Get Complaint Feedback, Get Complaint Risk/Sentiment, Notify Internal Team.

Times and dates are dealer-local (+04:00). Fields with no value are omitted rather than sent as null. No authentication yet.

Red-font fields of a row are part of its response but always empty ("") - they do not come from Keyloop.

Customer phone numbers and e-mail addresses are masked in every response: a phone shows only its last three digits (+*********567), an e-mail its first letter and domain (a***@example.com). Searching by mobile or e-mail still works - the match comes back masked. The test-drive advisor is staff and is not masked.

item.name: Feedback Screen

request.description: Registered mobile first, then any other phone Keyloop holds (the spec's "search by another phone number"). Also email= or customerNumber=.
Customer ID, name, mobile, e-mail, branch. Loyalty Tier is in red font.
Identity verification is recorded in Genesys when the agent does it and no feed of it reaches this side: answers 501 after the usual 404 check. Verified By and Verification Date are in red font.

Feedback ID, origin (KEYLOOP / DESKTOP), Type (Keyloop: SERVICE / SALES / LOST_SALE from the survey; desktop: CSI / SERVICE / SALES / COMPLAINT / GENERAL), survey, Comments (a Keyloop entry writes its answers out, and lists them in answers[]), Date, newest first. from / to / limit optional. Channel, Reference and Score are red font: returned empty ("") - Keyloop's numeric answers ("10") stay in answers[].

Feedback Type, Comments, Date, answers[] - by Keyloop's response serial or by AGMC-<id> for feedback submitted here. Score, Channel and Interaction ID are red font. 404 until one exists: submit one, then run "Recent feedback for a customer", which fills {{feedbackId}}.

Every output on this row (CSI Score, Rating, Response Count, Trend) is in red font - scores are not held on this side - so the answer echoes what was asked (group, customerNumber, branch, from, to) with csiScore, rating, responseCount and trend returned empty (""). group is required.

Comments and Date of the customer's CSI feedback: what was submitted here as CSI, plus Keyloop's satisfaction surveys (after-sales service, handover, showroom visit). Response ID, Score and Channel are red font. from / to / limit optional.

The reasons in use on Keyloop's "Lost sale" enquiries, by branch and lost date (from=, to=), one row each: reasons[].reason is Keyloop's "Lost Sale Reason" text (export of 2026-09-21; the code stands in on an older enquiry that has only that) and reasons[].reasonCodes the lost event codes behind it (L01, L26...; Keyloop has two codes for some texts, so a reason is one row with both). Count and Percentage are in red font: reasons[].count and reasons[].percentage are returned empty ("").

item.name: Lost sales for a customer / date range

request.description: Lead / Opportunity ID (the enquiry number), Reason (Keyloop's lost sale reason text, with reasonCode = its lost event code), Date (the lost sale date), with the model and branch. customerNumber, branch, from, to are all optional; page with limit (default 100, max 1000) and offset. Value and Competitor / Outcome are red font: returned empty ("").

item.name: Open workshop bookings by Customer ID

request.description: Booking ID, Service Type, Date, Branch, Status from Keyloop's open-WIP export, across every car the customer bought. from / to bound the appointment date (a booking with no date only shows when neither is given).

Survey ID, Customer ID, Comments, Submitted Date (defaults to today; not in the future). type CSI / SERVICE / SALES / COMPLAINT / GENERAL (default); bookingId and branch optional. Score, Response ID and Submission Status are in red font: returned empty ("").
